_about: Tables for science/CHEMISTRY.md: the universal substance and reaction schemas, the domains the engine must cover, the initial database (small; the period's gases and fuels plus a few reactions that show the engine does not care what year it is), the kinetics and equilibrium fields, and the scope. Rex (2026-10-29): the chemistry is universal; the equipment is the limiter; the game is 1700, the engine is not. mark: rex | proposed | open. Tables moved whole to data/library/chemistry.json (no game columns): schema, reaction_fields.

substances.source: Standard chemical data; toxicity thresholds from occupational and clinical references: CO (COHb 10 to 20% headache, 20 to 30% drowsiness and ataxia, 30 to 50% seizures and unconsciousness, over 50% death; 200 ppm slight headache in 2 to 3 h, 800 ppm dizziness and convulsions in 45 min, 1,600 ppm death within 30 min; elimination half-life 4 to 6 h in air; CHM-CO), CO2 (1% drowsy, 3% headache and panting, 5% confusion, 8 to 10% unconsciousness; standard), H2S (10 ppm irritation, 100 ppm IDLH and olfactory fatigue, 500 ppm lethal in 30 to 60 min; CHM-H2S), SO2 (irritant: 5 ppm airway, 100 ppm IDLH), oxygen (hypoxia under 16%, unconsciousness under 10%).

reactions.title: The first reactions (combustion, fermentation, rot; and a set that shows the engine does not care what year it is)
reactions.source: Stoichiometry is exact; rates and conditions are placeholders. Black powder: 75% KNO3, 15% charcoal, 10% sulphur by mass; about 43% of products are gas (CO2, N2, CO, H2S, H2, CH4), 56% solids (potassium salts), about 330 cm3 of gas per gram; the products do not follow one simple equation (CHM-BP). Thermodynamic possibility is not kinetics: a reaction needs its conditions (ChatGPT's point, kept).

scope.title: Scope: universal engine, small first database (Rex, 2026-10-29)
scope.source: ChatGPT's position (outside AI): the engine's capability is not the game's need at any moment; the pirate period must not size the architecture. The keeper's caution: replacing GOODS.md's 183 recipes with reactions is a redesign of the economy's crafting and a decision of its own. Both recorded.
rows: The engine is universal: the game is 1700, the chemistry is not (Rex's own words via ChatGPT, 2026-10-29). Historical availability belongs to the world, economy, technology and crafting layers, never to the chemistry
The substance and reaction schemas are general: solids, liquids and gases; any route; any provenance; every domain in the domains table is a supported kind of record
The database starts small (16 substances, 18 reactions) and grows by records; an unsupported reaction is 'unknown', never impossible
Equipment is the limiter: the assembly pipeline (SCIENTIFIC_EQUIPMENT 3) decides whether an attempt runs; a tagged anomalous piece makes its processes possible at once with no change here

Crafting skill affects the minigame's control (temperature, timing, handling), never the chemistry; a player who knows a procedure may attempt it without a recipe; poor character skill makes it hard to execute
A discovery made before its historical date is a Time Anomaly in the journal, real all the same
Whether GOODS.md's 183 recipes become reactions of this engine (they can stay as the economy's shorthand over it)
not decided; the economy's lane and Rex's
Who keeps CHEMISTRY.md and the science folder after this
